about_the_game:
In Junkienator, you are a janitor with one task: clean up chaotic offices armed with your trusty vacuum cleaner. But it's not just about common dirt. You'll have to face animated junk that gets in your way muttering insults, and pesky black creatures that leave black stains everywhere. You'll use cunning, your tools, and even common objects in unexpected ways to make your way through.

When the job is done and you return home, everything changes. Creaking walls await you, a mother lost in her beloved vintage films, and the darkness of the night, populated by dark dreams that haunt your nights and try to resurface, forcing you to confront buried truths.

Vacuum, Throw, and Clean

The offices aren't just dirty, they're... alive! Use your powerful vacuum cleaner to suck up the annoying animated junk that hinders you and curses you under its breath. Watch out for the black creatures: these little things mess everything up! Kill them, then use water to erase their remains. Cleaning here is also self-defense!

Solve the Puzzles

Not everything is easily accessible. Some areas are off-limits; find a way to access them and complete your clean-up job!

Back home

At the end of the day, you return to your sweet and gloomy home. Say hi to Mom, do some chores, and try to get some rest. You've earned it.

Face your nightmares

Rest brings no peace. Every night, you plunge into vivid and terrifying nightmares that seem more real than they should be. Confront your past as it resurfaces.

content_descriptors.notes: This videogame may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Violence, Blood, General Mature Content. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460 or AMD FX™-6300 (we're still testing)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Clean the offices, solve puzzles, deal with pesky black creatures, and uncover dark secrets about your past. Play as a janitor in this first-person thriller. Cleaning is just the beginning, your past is the end.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian
*languages with full audio support
